title: Native shared UI tokens, workbench, keyboard command palette
summary: Source implementation of a session-only accessible M02 desktop GUI, design tokens, gallery, theme/density and command routing. Backend features remain disabled; visual acceptance pending. P02 regression follow-up: closed shortcut allowlist, fail-closed Windows CI stage separation and contrast-safe secondary text tokens (merge and native accessibility still pending). Modal isolation update: inert background, keyboard routing guard, stable focus return to opener or destination. P02-T02.04 addresses hidden focus on keyboard-focusable Workbench tabpanels with a theme-aware outline, adds fail-closed Windows Python a11y contracts and candidate native capture; final visual acceptance remains pending. T02.06/07: accessible gallery pressed/hover/disabled/status examples with independent sample input, responsive 900px-native gallery and bounded split-grid columns; screenshot candidates and native E2E review remain pending. Scopes T02.06/07 now have passing exact-source Windows CI and direct visual inspection of the SHA-bound native action/898px responsive screenshots (artifact 14804053291); full M02/P02 acceptance and release still pending. T02.09/10/11 scoped acceptance: Windows fail-closed native PNG/metadata verifier and 20 dedicated regression tests, 9 independently inspected SHA-bound real Tauri images and accurate eight-option Help/Wiki docs; full manifest and release remain pending. T02.12 readiness gate rejects false parent DONE, captures independent real native light/dark/keyboard-guide evidence and logs explicit NOT_READY blockers for 15 final M02 screenshots plus M02-OPT-03/04. Full M02 acceptance still unverified. Reviewdog P02 same-repository PR static review added with line-specific high-confidence diagnostics and isolated publication token; M02-OPT-03 compact properties spacing preview is now implemented as keyboard-accessible session-only React state. Actual editor, custom shortcut remapping, all screenshots, full P02 module acceptance and release remain pending. M02-OPT-03 illustrative compact properties toggle has passed Windows native screenshot visual review (SHA bound), and Reviewdog reporter passed scoped P02 static checks; full screenshot manifest and M02 module acceptance remain unfinished. M02-OPT-04 now supports collision-safe session-only Ctrl+1..6 navigation remapping and reset. Sidebar and palette labels update; exact-source Windows CI, Python and Node regression tests, native swap visual review passed. Final M02 image manifest and P02/P03 merge gates are not complete. P02-T04 functional acceptance completed for the real allowlisted command palette, Escape/no-match/Enter keyboard navigation, modal isolation, remappable shortcut announcements and source focus-return contract; native Windows 18 candidate images verified and 9 inspected. Final M02/M19 screenshot-manifest and phase release gates remain separate. P02-T03 scoped acceptance achieved: adaptive auto-collapse 78px rail, Alt+N expanded/restored, semantic breadcrumb and two named preview panes, 8 regression tests, exact-source GitHub native Tauri run 45171909447, 21 candidate PNG/hash pairs and 3 independently inspected 898x653 rail states. Official T03 DONE; full screenshot manifest and P02 phase release remain incomplete. M19 actual offline knowledge workflows implemented: 12 articles, strict versioned local search, 4 recovery wizards, FAQ/glossary, local Wiki mapping audit and safe article reports; exact-source Windows/Node/Python/Reviewdog/governance pass. M19 final screenshots and hosted Wiki still pending.
migration_notes: No native user-storage schema change or migrated data. UI session state only; offline help bundled from curated static source.
